results.title: From Soap‑Opera Star to Royal Aide: Beth Herlihy's Role in the Sussexes' Nottingham Walkabout
results.description: The former Kensington Palace employee and ex‑soap actress Beth Herlihy, who has been a key strategist for Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's public engagements, was seen supporting the couple during their recent walkabout in Nottingham. This article explores Herlihy's career shift, her advisory firm's high‑profile clients, and the financial arrangements that connect her to the Sussexes' philanthropic work.
